claim: Verify against the game's own screen or buffer as well as your own model: a second independent comparison catches faults that hooks and the first model share.

evidence.text: Level-end curtain found by the attribute model at frame 16,420, not by looking.
evidence.quote: Curtain: found by the attribute model at frame 16,420, not by looking.

evidence.text: LDI's DE carries out of column 255 into the next row; the whole-picture replay model caught it, hook registers and RAM alone did not.
evidence.quote: The whole-picture replay model caught it; hook registers and RAM alone did not.

evidence.text: Both one-pass effects came from the composite check, not from reading the code.
evidence.quote: Both one-pass effects above came from the check, not from reading the code.

evidence.text: An MMU line lost in a refactor showed at once as a picture against the model, where the eye would have taken a while.
